TRANSPARENCY

Roles, not people.

This board shows only how many volunteers each centre needs and how many have stepped up — by role, faculty and course. A volunteer's name, photo or contact detail never appears here unless they've given consent. It's how we stay accountable while protecting everyone who gives their time.
